title: OpenInvest Minimal Evidence Layer v1 record envelope
description: P2-0 Minimal Evidence v1 (JUDGE approved 2026-09-06). Observation layer only: records facts about Policy Search -> Policy View -> Human Need Observation plus manual E3 inbound. Never VERIFIED; verification_status field forbidden anywhere (Trust isolation). Append-only: records immutable, state changes expressed as separate TRANSITION records.

observation_status.description: UNVERIFIED_OBSERVATION (default) / CANDIDATE (human-recorded E3 inbound or manual promotion) / ARCHIVED_INVALID_ANCHOR (legacy classification only). VERIFIED is reserved for the Trust Layer human gate and has no code path in this layer.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO8601 at record creation; never backfilled.

actor_hash.description: v1: always null per JUDGE ruling (no IP capture, no daily salt).

payload.description: Event-specific facts, stored verbatim. POLICY_SEARCHED: {keyword, result_count}. POLICY_VIEWED: {policy_id, is_mock_snapshot}. NEED_SUBMITTED: {need_text, contact_or_callback}. E3_INBOUND_RECORDED: {description, participant_class, org_name, contact, recorded_by}.

anchor_policy_id.description: Set only if the policy id existed in the current dataset at write time (prevents dangling anchors such as legacy policy_id=3).

evidence_refs.description: References to real interaction evidence. Null until such evidence exists (prefer null over guessing).

not.description: Trust isolation: the verification_status key is forbidden at every nesting level (enforced by evidence_store._assert_no_forbidden_keys).
